institution_scope.institution_query_binding: Concrete per-org, per-L, per-language bindings frozen here; original affiliation variants are in organizations.jsonl. Record each provider request and its language/affiliation coverage limits. Core laboratory/author routes are not restricted to this topical query; the topical gate controls only other-team institution expansion.

source_query_templates.limitations: TITLE_ABS/AFF syntax has known-positive/negative seed tests; actual institution queries are pending P5. Date filter uses day precision, and article indexing/affiliations are incomplete. A failed or empty result never proves absence.

expansion_policy.pause_action: persist every remaining task, cursor and failure; do not discard discovered Works

exclusions.reason: No bypass of paywalls/access controls; retain bibliography when access is unavailable.
Reject deep parsing until a verified discovery path and lawful access are established.

access_and_license.abstract_policy: Chinese summaries with source/author/date; verbatim only with verified permission.
access_and_license.sensitive_cache: Private local cache; Git contains sanitized metadata/locators/summary/logs only.

resource_limits.retry_policy: Retry-After if provided; otherwise bounded backoff 2/5/15 seconds, then retryable_error. Do not repeat exhausted daily quota in this run.

budget.reset_rule: New run retains the same scope and cursor; a new snapshot requires a new scope.
